rights.scope: Amphora-authored synthetic SPC universes modeling scenarios cited in Shewhart 1931, Roberts 1959, Page 1954, Montgomery 2020 Ch. 6/9, and NIST/SEMATECH Sec. 6.3.2. No copyrighted textbook values reproduced; every numeric value is Amphora hand-constructed from closed-form pattern mu + ((seq-1) mod 5 - 2)*delta with delta=0.1 (or drift/shift derivations thereof).

universes.industrial_context: solvent-borne primer viscosity (mPa*s) held at nominal during a stable-run period
universes.nominal_source: Montgomery 2020 8th ed. Ch. 6 Sec. 6.4 (individuals chart, stable-baseline zero-alert control case); NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook Sec. 6.3.2

universes.industrial_context: cure gel-time (min) with mild lot-to-lot bias after supplier change at batch 25
universes.nominal_source: Roberts 1959 Technometrics 1(3):239-250 (EWMA for small persistent shift); Montgomery 2020 8th ed. Ch. 9 Sec. 9.2 (EWMA vs. Shewhart for 1sigma shift)

universes.industrial_context: batch dry-film-thickness (mils) with equipment-drift bias after airless-spray retooling
universes.nominal_source: Montgomery 2020 8th ed. Example 6.3 pattern (2sigma persistent shift); NIST/SEMATECH Sec. 6.3.2 Shewhart individuals

universes.industrial_context: adhesion pull-off (MPa) with severe substrate-prep failure after batch 25
universes.nominal_source: Shewhart 1931 Economic Control of Quality of Manufactured Product Ch. III (large shift trivially detected by 3-sigma chart); NIST/SEMATECH Sec. 6.3.2

universes.industrial_context: amine-hardener stoichiometry (phr) with slow supplier-dispenser wear over batches 21-45
universes.nominal_source: Page 1954 Biometrika 41(1/2):100-115 (continuous inspection for accumulated drift); Montgomery 2020 Ch. 9 Sec. 9.1 (CUSUM detects drift earlier than Shewhart)

universes.industrial_context: solvent lot-purity metric (pct) with single contamination event at batch 30
universes.nominal_source: Shewhart 1931 Ch. III (large single-point excursion where individuals chart wins over MR); Montgomery 2020 Ch. 6 Sec. 6.4 (individuals chart is fastest for isolated outlier)

universes.industrial_context: dry-film thickness (mils) held in control but violating tight application spec
universes.nominal_source: NIST/SEMATECH Sec. 6.3.2.4 (control limits != specification limits); Juran 1999 Sec. 45.9 (Cp vs. Cpk - spec vs. control separation)

universes.industrial_context: gloss (60 deg) with factory-wide equipment-warmup drift not yet touching customer spec
universes.nominal_source: Montgomery 2020 Ch. 6 (control-vs-spec distinction; process out of control but inside spec still a Special Cause)

universes.industrial_context: primer thickness at nominal with tight-spec but exactly-at-limit boundary conformance
universes.nominal_source: NIST/SEMATECH Sec. 6.3.2 (boundary handling with strict inequalities); Montgomery 2020 Ch. 6

universes.industrial_context: long-baseline stability run for potlife (h) sanity control
universes.nominal_source: Shewhart 1931 (baseline size influence on sigma estimation); Montgomery 2020 Ch. 6 (n>=25 recommended for individuals baseline)
